examples.title: The shape of a certificate (paths and tags only)
Read the serial number of a certificate (tbsCertificate.serialNumber)

description: Read-only X.690 view of any DER object (BER with encodingRules:'ber'): the node tree — offset, header and content lengths, tag class / number / name, constructed flag, child count, a hex preview of each primitive (maxPreviewBytes, default 32) and the dotted value + registered name of every OBJECT IDENTIFIER — depth-first, capped at 20000 nodes (truncated:true). `nodePath` ('0.2.1' = child indices from the root; each node's `path` is what to pass) narrows to a subtree; `read` applies a typed reader to the selected node (boolean, integer, small-integer, enumerated, null, bit-string, octet-string, oid, relative-oid, string with stringType for an IMPLICIT tag, time with timeType) and returns `value` in wire form (bigint as decimal string, bytes as hex, time as epoch ms + ISO); `reencode:true` re-encodes the selected node through the engine and delivers it as an artefact (der / hex / pem for a labelled whole input; inline or a sandbox file) with reencode.identical; `sequence:true` decodes several top-level values back to back; allowTrailingData:true tolerates bytes after a single value. Refuses a private key or a PKCS#12 file — by PEM label, or when the DER parses as PKCS#8 / PKCS#12 — with SECURITY_VIOLATION (inspect_private_key / inspect_pkcs12 report them safely); a missing nodePath step is NOT_FOUND naming the range; a wrong reader tag is PKI_ASN1_UNEXPECTED_TAG; an IMPLICIT string / time without stringType / timeType is PKI_API_MISUSE; X.690 violations are PKI_ASN1_* (BER forms: encodingRules:'ber'). Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary' (node count, root tag, value), fields:['nodes.path','nodes.tagName'].

allowTrailingData.description: Accept bytes after the outermost value instead of PKI_ASN1_TRAILING_DATA (single value only; sequence:true decodes them instead).

encoding.description: Artefact encoding: 'pem' (RFC 7468 text), 'der' (raw bytes), 'hex' (lowercase hex in structuredContent, inline only, ≤ 64 KiB). Default 'der'.

encodingRules.description: 'der' (strict X.690 DER, default) or 'ber' (indefinite / non-minimal lengths and constructed strings, as legacy CMS producers write).

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep after verbosity (arrays map over elements); unmatched paths land in _meta.unmatchedFields.

input.description: The DER / BER object (any PEM label except a private key, or DER): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path. A private key or a PKCS#12 file is refused (SECURITY_VIOLATION).

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

label.description: reencode + encoding:'pem': the PEM label of the artefact (required when the input had no label or nodePath selects a sub-node; upper-case words and digits). A private-key label is refused.

limits.description: Raise pkinative's 22 named security bounds for this call (trusted input only; absent keys keep the engine defaults). A value above an operator ceiling (PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED) is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED; describe_engine lists the defaults and the ceilings.

maxAttributes.description: The attributes of one attribute set. Default 256.

maxBerSegments.description: The segments joined from one BER constructed string. Default 10000.

maxChainLength.description: The certificates one certification path may hold. Default 10.

maxCmsCertificatesAndCrls.description: The certificates and revocation entries one SignedData carries. Default 1024.

maxDepth.description: The nesting depth of constructed values. Default 64.

maxExtensions.description: The extensions of one certificate or request. Default 256.

maxGeneralNames.description: The GeneralName entries of one field. Default 10000.

maxInputBytes.description: The size of one DER input, or the length of one PEM text. Default 67108864.

maxIntegerBytes.description: The content length of one INTEGER converted to a bigint. Default 8192.

maxKdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iteration count honoured in one derivation. Default 10000000.

maxNameAttributes.description: The attributes of one distinguished name. Default 1024.

maxNodes.description: The number of values decoded from one input. Default 200000.

maxOcspSingleResponses.description: The SingleResponse entries of one OCSP response. Default 256.

maxOidBytes.description: The content length of one OBJECT IDENTIFIER. Default 256.

maxPathsExplored.description: The candidate paths explored while building one (the RFC 5280 §6 work bound). Default 1000.

maxPemBlocks.description: The blocks read from one PEM text. Default 10000.

maxPkcs12Bags.description: The SafeBags read from one PKCS#12, across every SafeContents. Default 4096.

maxPkcs12KdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iterations one PKCS#12 costs in total. Default 10000000.

maxPolicies.description: The policies or policy mappings of one extension. Default 1024.

maxPolicyNodes.description: The live nodes of the RFC 5280 valid_policy_tree. Default 4096.

maxRevokedCertificates.description: The entries walked in one CRL revokedCertificates list. Default 1000000.

maxSignerInfos.description: The signers of one SignedData. Default 64.

maxPreviewBytes.description: Content bytes of a primitive shown in `preview` (hex; 0 hides previews; default 32).

nodePath.description: Child indices from the root, dot-separated ('0.2.1' = children[0].children[2].children[1]): the subtree listed, read or re-encoded. Omitted: the root. NOT_FOUND names the available range.

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default) returns the artefact inline as an embedded resource (≤ 50 MiB). 'file' writes it inside PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR (never overwrites; ≤ 1 GiB) and returns a resource_link.

outputPath.description: Relative path inside the sandbox (only when outputMode='file'); the extension must match the encoding (.der .bin .asn1 for der; .pem for pem). Key-bearing extensions (.key .p8 .p12 .pfx) are refused: nothing here writes a private key.

pemMode.description: 'strict' (RFC 7468 exactly, default) or 'lax' (tolerates whitespace, line length and RFC 1421 headers).

read.description: Apply this typed reader to the selected node (the root without nodePath) and return `value`; a wrong tag is PKI_ASN1_UNEXPECTED_TAG.

reencode.description: Re-encode the selected node through the engine encoder and deliver it as an artefact (`encoding` der by default, hex, or pem under the input label or `label`); `reencode.identical` says whether the bytes are the input bytes.

sequence.description: The input is several top-level values back to back: decode each (exclusive with nodePath / read / reencode).

strict.description: Escalate the first engine warning to a PKI_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of listing it in diagnostics[].

stringType.description: read:'string' on an IMPLICIT-tagged node: the charset to decode with (required then — PKI_API_MISUSE otherwise).

timeType.description: read:'time' on an IMPLICIT-tagged node: the time type (required then).

name: decode_asn1

outputSchema.description: The ASN.1 node tree, a typed value, or the re-encoded artefact facts. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

artefact.description: The artefact delivered alongside the report: its facts here, its bytes once as the embedded resource (or the resource_link in file mode).

hex.description: The artefact as lowercase hex (when encoding='hex').

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DER bytes (lowercase hex) — the reproducibility proof.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal concerns the engine raised (PKI_DIAG_*, de-duplicated, at most 200; explain_code explains one).

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when distinct diagnostics beyond the 200 listed were dropped.

label.description: The PEM label of the input, null for DER.

nodes.description: The selected subtree (or every top-level tree with sequence:true), depth-first in input order.

offset.description: Offset of the identifier octet in the input.

oid.description: OBJECT IDENTIFIER only: the dotted value.

oidName.description: OBJECT IDENTIFIER only: the registered name.

path.description: Child indices from the root ('' for the root, '0.2' for children[0].children[2]) — what nodePath takes.

preview.description: Primitive only: the first maxPreviewBytes content bytes as hex.

previewTruncated.description: Present when the content is longer than the preview.

root.description: Index of the top-level value (0 unless sequence:true).

identical.description: The re-encoded bytes equal the input bytes of the node.

rootTag.description: tagName of the first node listed (null when nothing was listed).

truncated.description: true when the listing stopped at 20000 nodes (use nodePath to walk the rest).

value.description: read: the typed value. boolean → boolean; integer / enumerated → decimal string; small-integer → number; null → null; bit-string → { hex, unusedBits }; octet-string → hex; oid / relative-oid → dotted string (name for a registered OID); string → { stringType, value }; time → { type, epochMilliseconds, iso, text }.

title: Decode ASN.1 (node tree, typed read, re-encode)
